summary.text: Trish La Chica is a Democrat who represents District 37 in the Hawaiʻi House of Representatives, according to the Legislature's directory.
The House Majority Caucus member page describes the district as portions of Mililani Town, Mililani Mauka, Koa Ridge and Waipiʻo Gentry.
